tei:div.tei:p: mos gus bla ma'i lam khyer bzhugs/

tho rengs mal nas ldang ba'i dus/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che mkhyen no/ bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lus la bde ba skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ ngag la nus pa 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs/ sems la rtogs pa 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ tshe 'di blo yis thong bar byin gyis rlobs/ nges 'byung blo sna skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ bdag 'dzin 'khrul ba 'jig par byin gyis rlobs/ byang chub sems mchog skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes bla ma la mos gus phur tshugs su bya'o//
